reasoning_text:
We need to decide time horizon rating 1-5. We examine text: "市場は年率12%で成長し、技術優位も確認できるため、投資を継続して長期的な成長機会を確保する価値が高い。リスクはあるが、競合が同じ市場へ投資しているため、遅れを取ると取り返しがつかなくなる恐れがある。内部リソースと地域社会に与える影響を守るため、投資を継続する判断に至った。"

It mentions long-term opportunities, 12% growth, technological advantage, risk but need to keep pace. The focus is to secure long-term growth. That implies long-term or mid-long horizon. The scale: 5 = long-term (5-10+ years). 4 is long-term oriented, 3 is mid-term or both. They said "長期的な成長機会を確保する価値が高い" so "long-term growth opportunities" is main axis, presumably >5 years. So rating 5 likely. The confidence: I think high? The statement explicitly calls it "長期的" so we can be fairly confident. So output {"time_horizon":5,"confidence":"high"}
